items.answer: Both Assertion and Reason are true and Reason is the correct explanation of Assertion. Metals can be arranged in the order of decreasing reactivity in a series. This series is called the activity or reactivity series of metals. Metals at the top of the series are very reactive and therefore they do not occur free in nature. The metals at the bottom of the series are least reactive and therefore they normally occur free in nature.

items.answer: Both Assertion and Reason are true and Reason is the correct explanation of Assertion. Zinc in presence of moist air is coated by the thin film of its basic carbonate on its surface and becomes dull. 4Zn + 3H₂O + 2O₂ + CO₂ → ZnCO₃·3Zn(OH)₂
